title: OWM-Dataset
description: This dataset contains processed intracranial EEG recordings from frontal (middle frontal gyrus) and temporal (middle temporal gyrus) areas of 13 epilepsy patients performing a load-3 object working memory task. Trials are 6498 ms long (fixation, encoding, and delay periods) and include only those retained after artifact rejection. Per-subject trial indexes and behavioral performance tables are provided as source data.
methods_description: Intracranial EEG was recorded from epilepsy patients during an object working memory task with 1000 ms fixation, 1500 ms encoding, and 3998 ms delay. Data were preprocessed with artifact rejection, and trials per channel were concatenated and zero-padded into EDF format.

funding_references.funder_name: K12 grant from the Neurosurgery Career Development Award, parent award from the NINDS as well as a Neurosurgery Research Education Fund award
